description: This file is a Java class implementing the OrderProductDownloadService, providing functionality related to order product downloads in an e-commerce system. It manages dependencies such as invoicing, shipping, payments, taxes, customers, and transactions, and defines methods for retrieving downloads by order ID.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of OrderProductDownloadService, providing methods for managing order product downloads, with dependencies injected for related services.

methods.name: getByOrderId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderProductDownload objects associated with a specific order ID.
